profile.backstoryText: My journey began in 2019, when I first discovered the magic of turning ideas into digital reality. Since then, I've been on a quest to master the art of software development, crafting experiences that blend creativity with technical excellence. Every project is a new adventure, every bug a puzzle to solve.
